description_en: Queries the daily peak number of concurrent upstream ingest streams for a user
description_zh: 查询用户的每日上行并发推流数峰值
name: DescribeUpPeakPublishStreamData

parameters.help_en: The start time of stream pulling in UTC. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 拉流开始时间，UTC格式, StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of stream pulling in UTC. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 拉流结束时间，UTC格式, StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内，且EndTime超过当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The domain name statistics switch. Valid values:

on: enables domain name-level statistics.
off: user-level data. User-level data is collected by default
parameters.help_zh:
域名统计开关，取值：

on：开启域名统计级别。
off：用户级别数据，默认统计用户级别数据
parameters.name: domain_switch

DescribeUpPeakPublishStreamData.description_en: The daily peak concurrent stream ingest data
DescribeUpPeakPublishStreamData.description_zh: 每日峰值并发推流数据

items.description_en: The daily peak concurrent stream ingest data
items.description_zh: 每日峰值并发推流数据

PeakTime.description_en: The peak time of the daily peak number of concurrent ingest streams. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
PeakTime.description_zh: 每日峰值并发推流数的峰值时刻。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

PublishStreamNum.description_en: The daily peak number of concurrent ingest streams

QueryTime.description_en: The queried daily time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
QueryTime.description_zh: 查询的每日时间。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间，格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

StatName.description_en: The name of the statistics attribute. When DomainSwitch is set to on, the live streaming domain name is displayed. When DomainSwitch is set to off or is not specified, the user ID is displayed
StatName.description_zh: 统计数据属性名称。当DomainSwitch取值为on时，显示用户直播域名；为off或者不传值是显示用户Id
